overview_description.description:
Portainer is a universal container management platform to deploy, configure, troubleshoot, and secure containerized applications across cloud, data center, edge, and Industrial IoT use cases. Portainer is trusted by customers across various industries, including financial services, information technology, manufacturing, energy, automotive, and healthcare, to simplify the adoption of containers securely with exceptional speed.

Portainer offers the perfect blend of infrastructure versatility, self-service freedom, and compliance guardrails to deliver containerized applications in a way that suits every part of the organization. Portainer provides extensive support for container orchestrators across every deployment scenario and helps bridge the knowledge gap within every organization.

about_short_description.short_description: Portainer is a container management platform to accelerate container adoption across cloud, datacenter, edge, and Industrial IoT use cases.

product.name: Portainer Container Management Platform
product.description: A platform for managing containerized applications across Docker, Kubernetes, and Podman environments with multi-cluster and multi-device support.

product.name: Portainer Business Edition
product.description: A commercial version of Portainer with extended features like role-based access control, registry management, and commercial support for enterprise use.

product.name: Portainer Community Edition
product.description: A free, open-source version of Portainer designed for individual users and small teams to manage containers with community support.

product.name: Portainer Academy
product.description: A self-paced training platform offering courses and tutorials on setting up, using, and managing Portainer and container deployments.

product.name: Portainer Developer Self Service Portal
product.description: A portal that enables teams to access and manage containerized environments with controlled permissions and simplified deployment workflows.

product.name: Portainer Managed Platform Services
product.description: Professional services offering platform engineering support to assist organizations in container adoption and ongoing management.
